scenes.narration: Walmart made 713 billion dollars. And kept only about 4 cents per dollar.
Then it found a side business. Ads.
But about 280 million people visit each week. And brands pay to be seen.
That ad business hit nearly 6.4 billion dollars.
Then memberships and other income added about 6.8 billion more.
